[LCRS.10.6.1] The engine has no concept of a disconnected adapter
([NADP.5.1.1]). If a rule fires a call whose adapter cannot
reach whatever it fronts, the callback returns `CallError`
with an `adapter.*` code whose leaf the adapter chooses ([LECC.4.3]) — DS
ships no adapters and specifies no leaf for this. Rules that want to
react match on that code; rules that don't get the standard
timeout idiom.
